rules.name: PrimaryResearchTrigger
rules.rule: If a priority need requires a school/UAT-specific perception, skills, practice-quality, career-intention or service-access claim and no direct local evidence exists, the system must generate a primary-research requirement rather than generalize national evidence.
rules.implementation: emit EVIDENCE_GAP + PRIMARY_RESEARCH_TASK; block school-specific wording until data is validated

rules.name: OfficialLocalBeforeGeneric
rules.rule: Before using national/regional labour evidence for a local project, search official county/UAT sources and the actual school educational offer. Local official evidence outranks generic contextual material.
rules.implementation: research planner order: school/ISJ -> AJOFM/INS county -> regional -> national -> EU

rules.name: QualificationDemandJoin
rules.rule: For IPT projects, build an explicit join between school qualification/domain offer and local employer sector/occupation demand before ranking labour-market alignment needs.
rules.implementation: qualification/domain -> COR/ISCO family when possible -> CAEN/NACE sector -> local demand evidence

rules.name: RateShareSemanticGuard
rules.rule: Never relabel a composition share, stock count or registered-unemployment measure as an unemployment/employment rate. Preserve numerator, denominator and universe.
rules.implementation: evidence schema must store measure_type, numerator, denominator/universe and calculation flag

rules.name: PublicationReceiptGate
rules.rule: Historical reconstruction requires both observation period and evidence that the source was available by the historical cutoff. If migrated pages lose original publication metadata, mark evidence conditional until archive/hash/receipt is captured.
rules.implementation: historical_availability in {verified, conditional, excluded}; conditional evidence cannot be sole support for a high-priority need

rules.name: ComplianceIsNotNeed
rules.rule: Horizontal obligations such as nondiscrimination, DNSH or equality are not diagnosed needs merely because the guide requires them. Promote them to a need only when target-group evidence demonstrates a relevant problem.

rules.name: IndicatorDoesNotCreateNeed
rules.rule: A programme indicator or preselected project result cannot itself establish a need. If no independent evidence shows a certification/completion deficit, qualification outcome remains an intervention/result target, not a diagnosed problem.
rules.implementation: need discovery excludes indicator text from evidence pool; indicators enter only at traceability stage

rules.name: NeedDecompositionAndDedup
rules.rule: Broad legacy formulations such as 'early preparation for labour-market requirements' should be decomposed into independently evidenced mechanisms (practice exposure, career guidance, employer linkage, qualification-demand fit) and deduplicated before ranking.
rules.implementation: semantic clustering + causal dependency graph before final need IDs

rules.name: AcceptedDoesNotEqualTrue
rules.rule: Evaluator acceptance is benchmark metadata, not factual validation. Unsupported or internally inconsistent accepted claims remain defects and must not be learned as truth.
rules.implementation: ground_truth records accepted_by_evaluator and evidence_strength separately

rules.name: PrimaryResearchIntegrity
rules.rule: When primary research is used, raw response table is the canonical source. Narrative, charts and conclusions are generated from it; manual chart values or duplicated visual series are prohibited.
rules.implementation: raw_responses -> deterministic aggregation -> charts/narrative; sample N and missingness assertions in QA

rules.name: PopulationVersionLock
rules.rule: Qualification/cohort/base-population changes are versioned. A later CF population cannot be used to silently rewrite the historical needs-analysis population.
rules.implementation: population_snapshot_id attached to every school-level evidence item and need

rules.name: EvidenceGapIsValidOutput
rules.rule: A high-quality needs analysis may explicitly state that a plausible school-specific claim is not yet demonstrated. Evidence gaps must trigger research tasks, not filler prose.
rules.implementation: EVIDENCE_GAP is a first-class artifact and can block final narrative release

product_implication: The next required product component is a Primary Research Engine that is invoked by evidence gaps before narrative generation.
